name: Any industry
description: Questions for every discovery conversation, whatever the industry. The goal is a problem worth solving, in the customer's words, not a fit for a package.

discoveryQuestions.text: Which business processes take the most time?
What repetitive work frustrates your employees or managers?
Where do tasks get delayed, duplicated or forgotten?
Which operational problems cost money or hurt customer satisfaction?
What business software do you already use?
What have you tried to improve this, and what happened?
What would you most want automated or handled for you?
What outcome would justify paying for a managed service?
